rows.en: And then… beyond the cave, the obsessed man obtained the demon sword granted only to the Creation King: the Satan Saber!
All preparations are complete!

Can you hear me? Shadow Moon!

Now the time has come for you to receive life energy and awaken from your long sleep… Awaken! Shadow Moon!!
It's working! The life energy is flowing in…
That's enough!
The next Creation King… has been decided: I, Swordsaint Birugenia!
What!? Birugenia… Don't tell me that sword is…? The Satan Saber!

Behold! The Satan Saber, granted only to the Creation King, has just now become mine, Birugenia's!

I am the next Creation King! Satan Cross!!

…!?

You… How dare you wreck the life energy infusion device!
Kukuku… Ha ha ha ha ha!
It's around here, right? The place where we got the report saying "A Shocker monster has appeared!"?
Hey, Shiro… Don't you mean Destron?
Or a Gorgom monster…?
No… The information came from the Boy Kamen Rider Squad! They wouldn't make a mistake like…
…!? So it really is Shocker?
Gel-Shocker's here too!
Revived monsters!? The ones who'd do something like this… Destron! What are they scheming?
These are Destron's greatest enemies… Kamen Riiider V3 and his comrades!! What are your impressions?
Colonel Zol…
Doctor Death!
Ambassador Hell…
General Black!!
Heh heh heh… So that's Rider V3. Not bad… not bad at all!
But it hardly takes all five of us great demon commanders joining forces to defeat Rider V3!
Ambassador Hell is right. My pride won't allow it!!
I would like to hear the Great Leader's thinking!

Great commanders of Shocker and Gel-Shocker! Now, don't be so hasty to reach conclusions.

Why did I use Destron's revival technology to bring you all back to life… Do you understand?
Well… that is, of course…
Is it your order that we take over command of Destron in place of Doktor G?
What nonsense is this!?
It's quite possible!
Stop this squabbling! I gathered all the great commanders here to begin Operation Annihilate Japan!
Operation Annihilate Japan?

That's right!

Our Destron has joined hands with the battle-fleet nation Naager to carry out Operation Annihilate Japan!
Naager, you say!?

The Riders, too, are gaining allies and expanding their strength day by day!

We too must at times join forces with other organizations to boost our strength!
Apfaron!? Surely not that man?
Atefarina!? Surely not that woman?
Exactly, Doctor Death…
I have used that Gigant they're so proud of… It was quite a fighting force.
Can that lot really be of any use?
There's no need to worry about that… If used well, that Gigant they're so proud of will be a fighting force too!
Hmm, I see…
Then, at once… begin Operation Annihilate Japan! Are you ready? Doktor G!!
Leave it to me… Together with them, I shall make Operation Annihilate Japan a success without fail!
Mm… As of today, Destron is reborn as the New Destron!
…What did you say!? If Shadow Moon cannot be revived, Birugenia will be the next Creation King!?
Please wait! He deliberately interfered with Shadow Moon's revival!
What!? Then you want us to use the stones of "Heaven", "Sea" and "Earth"…
That…! That we cannot do!
Gigant!? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too!?
Gigant? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too!?
Gigant!? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too!?
Gigant!? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too!?
Gigant…!? Damn you, Destron… You've joined hands with Naager, haven't you?
Gigant…!? Damn you, Destron… You've joined hands with Naager, haven't you?
Gigant!? Damn you, Destron… You've joined hands with Naager, haven't you?
Gigant!? Damn you, Destron… You've joined hands with Naager, haven't you?
Gigant!? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too?
Gigant!? So Destron has joined hands with Naager too?

What does Lord Creation King intend?

On one hand… he gives Birugenia the Satan Saber! On the other, he tells us to revive Shadow Moon…?

He's probably hedging his bets!

He must be planning to pit Shadow Moon and Birugenia against each other, and make the one left standing the next Creation King!
But to tell us to use the energy of the stones of Heaven, Sea and Earth embedded in our bodies… that's too cruel…

The three stones are the source of our lives!

If we use up their energy to revive Shadow Moon… that will be the end of our lives…
…We have no choice! If Birugenia rules, we're finished too…

Lord Creation Kiiing!!

I, Archpriest Darom… offer the Stone of Heaven for the revival of Shadow Moon…
I, Archpriest Baraom… likewise offer the Stone of Sea for the revival of Shadow Moon…
I, Archpriest Bishium… likewise offer the Stone of Earth for the revival of Shadow Moon…
Heaveeen!!
Seaaa!!
Earth!!
Now… here the three stones combine, and we offer them for the revival of Shadow Moon…
Grr, it's no use…?
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
